verdict.rationale: GitHub Projects has its own built-in workflows that automatically set fields whenever items are added or changed. That is event-triggered automation that runs each time those events occur, but nothing in the evidence shows time-based scheduling. GitHub Actions and the GraphQL API are host-platform and developer building blocks, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: scheduled or cron-style triggers, recurring time-based events, workflow actions beyond setting fields, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can create a workflow that runs on a schedule or recurring event to handle routine team work

citations.quote: Built-in workflows allow you to automatically set fields when items are added or changed
